tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Night = Midnight Mall navy (P0 slot 00); Day = softened Pastel Morning mauve.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Window/panel bodies, cards, form fields (P0 slot 01).

tokens.name: panel-hi
tokens.usage: Raised rows, secondary buttons, and the panel-gradient end (P0 slot 02).

tokens.name: crt
tokens.usage: Dark terminal panel in BOTH themes: tickers, readouts, code. Only place phosphor text appears. Night uses the deepest well (P0 slot 15).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and the 2px window borders (P0 slot 05).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, metadata (P0 slot 06).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers (P0 slot 03). The hard 2px window/button outlines use `ink`, not `line`.

tokens.name: sunset-pink
tokens.usage: Brand. Primary buttons, needs-you badges, active states, one call to action per screen (P0 slot 09). Day: fill only, never body text.

tokens.name: sunset-orange
tokens.usage: Warm amber accent: the sun motif, highlights, waiting state (P0 slot 11).

tokens.name: dusk-violet
tokens.usage: Deep accent: section bands, footer, and the first stop of the title-bar gradient (P0 slot 08).

tokens.name: cel-teal
tokens.usage: Cool accent: tags, secondary badges, Night links (P0 slot 07). Day teal is text-safe on surface/panel; use #3fa3a6 for larger teal fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on sunset-pink / cel-teal fills. Night uses ink (slot 15); Day uses marble (slot 04).

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text on dusk-violet bars (footer, gallery title bars).

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Mint CRT text (P0 slot 12), only on crt panels.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Rising numbers (mint, slot 12). Pair with ▲ so color is not the only signal.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Falling numbers (coral slot 10 night / red day). Pair with ▼ so color is not the only signal.

tokens.name: crt-gain
tokens.usage: Rising numbers on crt panels in both themes (gain's Day value is too dark there).

tokens.name: crt-loss
tokens.usage: Falling numbers on crt panels in both themes.

chrome.note: Hypnospace / VIBE OS skin (U2): Win95 bevel, pastel title bar, hard offset shadows, Bayer dither.

tokens.name: bevel-hi
tokens.usage: Win95 bevel highlight edge (inset 1px 1px 0).

tokens.name: bevel-lo
tokens.usage: Win95 bevel shadow edge (inset -1px -1px 0).

tokens.name: titlebar
tokens.usage: Pastel title-bar gradient (violet -> pink -> skin).

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Label colour on the pastel title bar / pastel fills.

tokens.name: panel-grad
tokens.usage: Subtle vertical panel gradient behind windows, cards and buttons.

tokens.name: bayer
tokens.usage: Faint 4x4 Bayer dither overlay on window bodies and crt reading surfaces. image-rendering: pixelated.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Hero title only, once per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles; Pixelify Sans has 500 and 700 cuts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, pixel nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and title bars; base grid unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Window padding, button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero padding, major section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: windows, buttons, images, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Maximum, for tiny chips only. Never round past this.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only, no blur. Windows/cards/buttons add a 1px Win95 bevel (inset highlight + shadow) on top of the hard offset. Night shadow is ink (#07040f); Day is rgba(43,24,64,0.38).

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Windows, cards, primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Button hover/pressed (move element +2px,+2px).
